FN-WTAZE9E-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 112
Committee: Boards, Agencies, and Commissions Sponsor: Representative Randall Shedd
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/04/2025
House Bill 112 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Onsite Wastewater
Board until October 1, 2029 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. The provisions of this bill
will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Page 1

House Bill 112
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Representative Randall Shedd
Economic Development
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/04/2025
House Bill 112 as passed the House of Representatives provides for the continuance of the
Alabama Onsite Wastewater Board until October 1, 2029 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law.
The provisions of this bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
